items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: I don't know Mr. Anderson Place.

ctx.x: This is my home in Zachary. Mm-hmm. Yes. I don't know Mr. Anderson Place. Mm-hmm. And we moved from Zachary in 28, nearby down there to Zion City. And we've been there ever since. Well, I moved over here on there. Skyward over there. Mm-hmm. But I made it up in my mind to buy me a guitar one day. First guitar that I bought it, the string was sitting upon it so high until you had to take hand-match it down and try to get a sound out. Yeah. Yeah. A fella sold it to me for a darn my head. I gave him a darn my head…
